change_summary: Truncate large stale tool-result blobs in history (keep the 4 most recent verbatim; system policy untouched) to cut re-sent input tokens.
reason_for_change: Input tokens scale with turns*context because pass-through resends full history each of 28.5 mean turns; the costliest tasks (23 at 41 turns/$1.08, 54 at 43 turns/$0.95) are turn-heavy and re-echo large get_order_details JSON every generation. Truncating only OLD tool-result blobs shrinks per-turn input dramatically while keeping the system policy fully intact and preserving the most recent 4 tool results verbatim, so the model retains the detail it actually needs for the current step and success is held.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.6667 < floor 0.7283
hypothesis: The system prompt injects the full domain_policy verbatim on every turn via harness pass-through; with 28.5 mean turns/task, this re-sends thousands of policy tokens each generation. Compressing history and/or only keeping the policy in the system slot (already there) while dropping redundant re-reads dominates input-token cost.
